description: Unofficial Umaru Doma fan-art companion from Himouto! Umaru-chan. Original cozy gaming choreography includes controller troubleshooting, a final potato chip, a drink break, three articulated running directions and a small jump. Compact home-persona adaptation uses an orange hamster cape, opaque white shirt, berry-pink lounge shorts and closed slippers; simplified clothing and original animation are not official merchandise or canonical motion.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
